text:
sam: FYI Acme POC run failing perf SLOs — TTFT ~2.3s on /doc-search (spike during 5kq). Swarm please.
elaine: can you paste request_ids + model + deployment id?
sam: request_id=01H4Z7Q9; model=redwood-7b-v2-quant; deployment=dedicated/us-west-2/dp-01; concurrency=6; client bursts ~60 qps.
sam: attaching recent log snippet:
```
2026-02-14T17:12:03Z error serving request 01H4Z7Q9: queue_wait_ms=1200 batch_size=1 x-cache-hit=MISS backend_latency_ms=800
2026-02-14T17:12:03Z warn kvcache: miss_rate=0.98 ttl_mismatch key=prefix:doc-*
```
elaine: ugh kv cache miss storm. are prompts hitting dynamic prefixes? any non-deterministic prompt args?
tariq: also seeing lots of 429s from GPU balancer before runtime: `rate-limited by swarm-controller` — probably exceeded per-instance concurrency cap.
mike: note: someone set batching_window_ms=0 for ultra-low latency; that prevents batching, so kernel startup overhead for tiny batches adds ~400-600ms to TTFT. recommend bump to 6-10ms.
jess: customer legal still wants private deployment checklist answered — will that change perf expectations?
elaine: private vs dedicated uses same runtime binaries but different network/KMS path; perf similar once in-region. Recommend enabling prefix KV caching (enable_cache=true), set `batching_window_ms=8` and `max_batch_size=32`.
elaine: rictl command to patch deployment:
```
rictl patch deployment dp-01 --set runtime.batching.window_ms=8 --set runtime.batching.max_batch_size=32 --set runtime.caching.prefix_kv.enabled=true
```
sam: doing that now. also can we temporarily relax throttle on dedicated pool for POC? sales asked about a one-time credit/discount if we push capacity.
jess: i'll escalate pricing to sales ops. please collect estimated token volume and duration.
sam: estimate: 1.2M tokens/day for 2 weeks peak.
deploy-bot: deploy dp-01 config patch started by sam at 2026-02-14T17:25:40Z :rocket:
deploy-bot: deploy finished in 21s — new batching_window_ms=8
tariq: after patch TTFT median dropped to 620ms, p95 1.1s. cache-hit jumped to 0.74. still seeing occasional 429s during bursts — recommend temporary concurrency bump + enable request queuing on client.
mike: also reduce per-request token limit to force more efficient batching: set max_input_tokens=1024 for POC.
sam: thanks team. @jess keep sales in the loop for pricing ask. I'll monitor next 12h and post metrics.
jess: 👍 thanks. keep notes for postmortem and Qs for security questionnaire.
elaine: adding a note — follow-up: update POC runbook to include caching TTL alignment and client-side backoff jitter.
sam: noted, will add to POC runbook.
